name: TrellisWM clean-room study
subject: TrellisWM 0.10.0 (build 560), app.trellisui.trelliswm
verdict: READY — authoritative results live in checks/report.json

method.study: Collect only observable evidence: public documentation, bundle metadata, shipped resources, user-visible UI strings (as terminology only), runtime logs and the app's own persisted documents on this Mac.
method.build: Write an independent implementation from the derived specification. No source code, disassembly output, logos, icons, artwork or prose from the subject is copied into the implementation.
method.check: Compare the derived specification against captured evidence; run unit tests; render the simulator headlessly.
method.ready: Report coverage, confidence and explicit limitations.

allowed: reading the app's own persisted layout documents under ~/Library/Application Support/TrellisWM
reading the app's own log under ~/Library/Logs
listing symbol names present in the Mach-O as terminology hints
excluded: copying the subject's localized prose (497 UI strings were read as terminology, not reproduced)
copying AppIcon.icns, MenuBarIcon.svg, Lessons assets or any artwork
bypassing licensing, trial or activation logic
reusing the bundle identifier, URL scheme owner name or product name in shipped code
boundaries.note: Clean room here means an independent implementation from observable behaviour, not an OS sandbox. The subject was inspected only on its owner's machine, at the owner's request.
